name: AMIA 2027 Amplify Informatics Conference
description: The American Medical Informatics Association holds its 2027 Amplify Informatics Conference at the Hyatt Regency Atlanta in Atlanta, Georgia. Starting in 2026, AMIA combined its former Informatics Summit and Clinical Informatics Conference into this single spring event.
